query:
SELECT empresaSlug,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as soma_cat9,
  COUNT(*) as total_dias,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dias_com_valor,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dias_zerados
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE tenantId = 1 
  AND empresaSlug IN ('MORUMBI', 'MASCOTE') 
  AND data >= '2026-03-01' 
  AND data <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
